text:
Mira: Quick callout — the compact confirmation that appears after changing a rollout weight is too terse and is causing a11y confusion. Mira: On keyboard swipe + NVDA the screen reader only reads "Confirm?" and the destructive verb is lost. :grimacing: Alex: Can you paste the markup or a screenshot? Mira: snippet below — we render a tiny dialog with two buttons, primary labeled 'Confirm' and secondary 'Cancel': ```html

Are you sure?

``` Mira: Because title is generic, screen readers don't get the action context. Also compact buttons lose visual affordance. Jordan: Two small tweaks that would help: 1) make primary CTA explicit (e.g., 'Confirm rollback' or 'Apply weight change') 2) add aria-describedby linking to a paragraph that states consequences (e.g., 'This will revert to v1 and notify users'). Jordan: Example copy: "Confirm rollback to v1 — traffic will shift immediately" as primary label (or just append the verb in the title). Sam: Strong +1 for explicit verbs. Also can we avoid btn-compact for destructive flows? touch target and focus ring are tiny. Mira: I'm leaning toward updating copy to 'Confirm rollback' and adding aria-describedby + visually-hidden extra context for assistive tech. Alex: + add data-analytics attr so product knows if users back out after seeing clearer copy (helps measure regressions). DevEx Bot: Heads up — compact button token (btn-compact) flagged in design-lint: reduces min-width below 44px. See ticket #DL-412. Mira: Great — I'll draft a patch: - change primary label to explicit verb - add

with consequences and link aria-describedby from dialog - remove btn-compact class for this dialog only - add E2E a11y check with NVDA/VoiceOver in CI Mira: Anyone opposed to the label "Confirm rollback" (short) vs "Confirm rollback to v1" (longer but explicit)? Jordan: Prefer shorter primary + detailed described text for screen readers. So primary = 'Confirm rollback', described text covers 'to v1 and traffic will shift immediately'. Sam: Works for me. Also add visual emphasis (red) for destructive action per pattern. Alex: I'll file a tiny PR checklist: copy update, aria, remove compact token, analytics hook. Mira: Thanks — I'll own the PR and ping @Alex and @Jordan for review. Planning to land before next sprint demo. :thumbsup: DevEx Bot: Reminder: deploy-preview CI will run axe-core a11y checks once PR is opened.
